comment: sp_lev.c flip_level() for conjoined pits (603-605, 612-614, and flip_encoded_dir_bits()): a debug Archeologist wishes for two adjacent pits, falls into the second, digs toward the first with the pick-axe so the two are conjoined ('You clear some debris from between the pits'), then #wizfliplevel 3 flips the level on both axes. She then tries to step into the first pit, now east of her, which reads the flipped pit state.
